changelog: Search media servers and torrent providers together or filter by source. Improve FTP folder indexing, add separate FTP and Torrent buttons, and add experimental torrent playback and media downloads.
description: Search private media servers, import links, and add movies, shows, or anime to Jellyfin as streams or local files.
name: Media Source Bridge
overview: Search private media sources and add streams or download media to Jellyfin libraries.
